🎥🍿: Ebenezer (Upcoming)

After shutting himself away from the world for decades, the ruthless Ebenezer Scrooge is haunted by a series of grotesque apparitions on Christmas Eve. Each spirit drags him deeper into a decaying world where forgotten memories, broken relationships, and abandoned dreams take on terrifying physical forms, forcing him to relive the moments that turned his heart to stone.

As the haunting intensifies, the Ghost of Christmas Present reveals the devastating consequences of Scrooge’s greed, while the Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come unveils a bleak future where his name is remembered only with fear and contempt. With time running out, Scrooge must confront the darkness consuming his soul before his fate is sealed forever.
